title: balance
content_html:
balance

The print of balance machine 1 gives us one arrangement to hold in view. The film raises questions about how long an equilibrium lasts and what it takes to find it again. The word carries us from weight and counterweight to the emotional effort of staying upright. How much movement can a state of balance contain? Print · Film

Reading note. Daoism. Chapter 77 of the Daodejing uses the bending of a bow to picture taking from excess and supplying what is deficient. The image makes balance an adjustment. Where does a correction take place in balance machine 1, and what happens to the rest of the arrangement when it does? Daodejing, 77
